result.title: A Failure-Driven Data Flywheel for Post-Training Vision-Language-Action Models
result.summary: Pretrained vision-language-action (VLA) models rarely satisfy all behavioral requirements of a new platform, and teams without a large deployed fleet lack the data to address the resulting failures. We propose a failure-driven data flywheel for post-training such models. It constructs target scenarios absent from the available data by inserting task-relevant entities into reconstructed real-world scenes, and evaluates the model against each behavioral requirement of the target task. Failure rates form a failure map across task conditions and difficulty levels, which is re-evaluated after each round and assigns larger data generation quotas to conditions where the model still fails. We instantiate the framework in autonomous driving for occluded-pedestrian emergence and yielding at stop-sign-controlled intersections, and evaluate it on two VLA models and one non-VLA planner in simulation and on a real vehicle. For occluded-pedestrian emergence, five rounds of post-training improve the critical-phase collision-free rate on the sealed test set from 0.261 to 0.579 for AutoVLA and from 0.390 to 0.765 for ReCogDrive, while the unnecessary braking rate in paired control scenarios never exceeds 0.013. On a full-scale vehicle without real-world training, post-trained ReCogDrive achieves 4 of 5 safe passages, versus 1 of 5 for the base model. Fine-grained evaluation reveals a pattern obscured by the collision-free rate alone: both VLA models learn anticipatory deceleration before reaching the occluding vehicle, while braking after pedestrian emergence remains limited. For stop-sign yielding, the stop-before-line rate rises from 0.100 to 0.897 for AutoVLA and from 0.000 to 0.667 for ReCogDrive. With sequential training from the pedestrian-capability models, it reaches 0.599 and 0.358, respectively, while the pedestrian collision-free rate decreases by at most 0.032.

AI.brief_summary: 提出失败驱动的数据飞轮用于 VLA 模型后训练：在重建的真实场景中插入任务相关实体以构造缺失的目标场景，按任务行为要求逐项评估模型，用失败率构成跨条件与难度的失败图，并据此分配下一轮数据生成配额；在自动驾驶的遮挡行人出现与停车标志让行场景中对两个 VLA 模型进行多轮后训练与仿真/实车验证。
AI.relevance_reason: 按失败条件分配数据生成配额的做法可能为 LVR 轨迹训练中把监督资源集中到失败条件的策略提供线索；其细粒度评估发现模型只学到「到达遮挡车前预先减速」而「行人出现后制动」仍不足，可供核查视觉证据使用时序与 latent 状态是否真正承载关键视觉信息。
